    AI Overview
    As of April 2026, former NBA star Lamar Odom has an estimated net worth of $20 million. Despite earning over $115 million during his 14-season NBA career, his fortune was significantly impacted by personal issues and health challenges. He has since rebuilt his finances through business ventures, including drug rehabilitation centers. 
    Key Financial Details: 
    • NBA Earnings: Odom earned roughly $115 million in salary, with his peak coming during his successful run with the Los Angeles Lakers, where he won two championships.
    • Post-NBA Revenue: Since retiring, he has earned money through his memoir, Darkness to Light, appearances in a Netflix documentary, and a high-profile celebrity boxing match.
    • Investments: He has invested in Odom Wellness, which operates addiction treatment centers in California.
    • Previous Financial Struggles: Following a near-fatal overdose in 2015, reports indicated a significant decrease in his assets. In 2022, he revealed he had sold his two championship rings for a combined total of $114,000 to improve his financial standing, as reported by Yahoo Finance. 
    While some sources in 2025 speculated a higher valuation, the prevailing estimate for his net worth in early 2026 is $20 million.
